## Design

### 2026-10-24 – oct. 24-25:Complete plan  of "pocketone"

**7h**

oct. 24-25:Complete plan  of "pocketone"

INTRO

Hello this is my first Journal entry for the project, but im already into the project for quite some time. The general idea as well as the Layout of pins and parts is done already.

My project is a MIDI Keyboard similar to the one from the tutorial. My boad has some more features and with the help of some clever additions it fits into any backback or big pocket. :D

These additions are some shift and hold features that make buttons usable for multiple things.

WHY AM I BUILDING THIS ?

I just thought it would be fun to create one and since im unexperienced in the field, im super excited to test it out and create some tuff music. :3

TABLE OF CONTENT

- Repo creation
- basic layout
- advanced layout
- every key usecase
- complete pin mapout
- all parts decided
- nearly complete BOM

- this journal and the first REEL ! XD

BASIC/ADVANCED LAYOUT

I created a basic layout and decided what features and buttons i wanted on the board. After that I altered my layout a bit more and changed some features. The board has now designated key and button places and a space for the display and ESP.

![IMG_ADVANDCED](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wKsIODyJMOqccfQq70tFSoimsjj2E03H/195646e613fdb81980bbf8b71c560a886f3414664e08c71e17c191e8433362d3.jpg)

![IMG_BASIC](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wKsIODyJMOqccfQq70tFSoimsjj2E03H/997e9ade73ad59d23b021da813a3bd8c4b230c7e463c30f75db41a171048ff32.jpg)

CONTROLL FEATURES

The board consists of several controlls. 3 big buttons, 5 small config buttons, 2 rotary encoders, 8 sensor pads, 3 faders, 13 keys, a display.

All these things have one sometimes also two bindings. I assigned every controll and moved on.

![BUTTONS](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wKsIODyJMOqccfQq70tFSoimsjj2E03H/aa4850a9405aea0ef0d381b369f4e8c33ff353276d77b7e53bf442a6de7ba6f7.jpg)

I also cooked up all menu features and infos that are shown on the OLED screen.
![OLED](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/wKsIODyJMOqccfQq70tFSoimsjj2E03H/88ddd92d21b1734d5c8fafe9f6a25af6bb59aff4056ad61896b01d851112539d.jpg)

I drew every pin connection on paper first because i like that more and its cleaner to make some changes in my opinion. I created 3 sheets wich will probably be copied 1 to 1 into KICAD.

Those mapings include the esp, the controlls, the display, etc but have a look yourself.
